name: watchparty-extension
description: Chrome extension client for the Netflix watch party

scripts.icons: node tools/gen-icon.mjs && sips -z 48 48 icons/icon128.png --out icons/icon48.png && sips -z 16 16 icons/icon128.png --out icons/icon16.png
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r -FS ../watchparty-extension.zip . -x '*.map' && cd .. && echo 'created watchparty-extension.zip'
